candidates.title: Telangana CID Raids Rice Mills, Arrests 14 Millers Over Irregularities
candidates.excerpt: The Telangana Crime Investigation Department (CID) launched massive, coordinated morning raids across multiple districts, detaining and arresting several rice millers for extensive irregularities.

candidates.title: BJD Seeks PM's Intervention to Resolve Odisha's Kotia Dispute With AP
candidates.excerpt: The BJD on Sunday sought Prime Minister Narendra Modi's intervention to resolve the decades-long dispute between Odisha and Andhra Pradesh over the Kotia cluster of villages.
